title: TRACE: Governing AI-Assisted Research with Principles from Computer Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.24035v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has made it easier than ever to produce research outputs. Adding an agentic tool to a research team's work potentially extends the team's capabilities but calls for an active approach to organizing the research process. The pressing question, therefore, is how research teams should organize their work with this technology. We contend that the question is not new: software engineering and security research have long studied how teams of people working with machines keep control of projects with many contributors. We distill principles from the practices these literatures report and transpose them to AI-assisted research. The principles form TRACE: Track records, Review against sources, Accept independently, Control transitions, and Evaluate corrections. Together, the five principles give researchers a common basis for remaining in control while integrating AI into their workflows. By bounding units of work

translated_title: TRACE：以计算机科学原理治理AI辅助研究
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）使产出研究成果变得前所未有地容易。将智能体工具加入研究团队的工作中，有望扩展团队的能力，但也要求采取积极主动的方式来组织研究过程。因此，紧迫的问题在于研究团队应如何围绕这项技术来组织工作。我们认为这个问题并不新鲜：软件工程与安全研究早已探索了人与机器协作的团队如何在众多贡献者参与的情况下保持对项目的掌控。我们从这些文献所报告的实践中提炼出原则，并将其迁移到AI辅助研究中。这些原则构成了TRACE：追踪记录、对照来源审查、独立采纳、控制转变、评估修正。这五项原则共同为研究人员在将AI整合进工作流程时保持掌控提供了共同基础。通过界定工作单元……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文借鉴软件工程与安全研究的成熟实践，提出TRACE五项原则（追踪记录、对照来源审查、独立采纳、控制转变、评估修正），为研究团队在整合AI工具时保持对研究过程的掌控提供了治理框架。
